# Digital Research CP/M 2.2 utilities

Archive: http://www.cpm.z80.de/download/cpm22-b.zip

Downloaded from the Unofficial CP/M Web Site. Its binary index identifies this
as the Xerox 1800 CP/M 2.2 distribution disk. Archive SHA-256:
`88735cca77e786505f53a63746ddbc5ca221eda79fd822fde5dc9f00a5bfba6f`.

The clarified Digital Research successor's redistribution/modification grant is
retained in cpm22/LICENSE.txt. The original ZIP is kept unchanged. This project
extracts only generic Digital Research transient tools; it does not use its
CPM.SYS, BIOS, disk maintenance or machine-specific system-generation code.

Preloaded: STAT, PIP, ED, ASM, LOAD, SUBMIT, DUMP. Full TSPico and Oliger utility
disks also include DDT and XSUB; smaller game collections may omit them. The archive
is binary provenance, not a claim that these tools were built from source here.
Project tools and examples are separate from these Digital Research utilities.
